dialogues.jp:
テレビでは、あまり見たこともないような新人
のお笑い芸人が巨大な鍋につかっていた。
dialogues.en:
The most interesting thing on TV was a variety show
featuring up-and-coming comedians.
dialogues.text:
The most interesting thing on TV was a variety show
featuring up-and-coming comedians.

dialogues.jp:
売れない芸人の宿命だろうが、美しくもない男
が大根やネギの格好をして煮込まれる姿は、｛ひい／贔｝
｛き／屓｝目に見ても大して面白いものでもない。
dialogues.en:
Even then, the thought of these guys jumping into giant pots
together wasn't my idea of fun.
dialogues.text:
Even then, the thought of these guys jumping into giant pots
together wasn't my idea of fun.

dialogues.jp:
なんで朝っぱらから、こんなの見てるんだ？
どうなのよ、俺？
dialogues.en:
What the hell am I doing, watching this at this time of the
morning?
dialogues.text:
What the hell am I doing, watching this at this time of the
morning?

dialogues.en: "*sigh*"
dialogues.text: "*sigh*"

dialogues.jp: 休みだというのに、つい普通に起きてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Even though it was the holidays, I woke up at the usual
time.
dialogues.text:
Even though it was the holidays, I woke up at the usual
time.

dialogues.jp:
学校に行かなくていいんだから、別に早起きす
る必要なんかないのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Although it's good not to have to go to school, without that
reason, waking up early is kinda pointless...
dialogues.text:
Although it's good not to have to go to school, without that
reason, waking up early is kinda pointless...

dialogues.jp:
昼まで寝るつもりだったのに……。染み付いた
生活リズムというのは恐ろしい。
dialogues.en:
Sleeping till noon is the best feeling after all... I guess
the rhythm of school life is hard to escape.
dialogues.text:
Sleeping till noon is the best feeling after all... I guess
the rhythm of school life is hard to escape.

dialogues.jp: といっても、起きたのは、９時過ぎだが。
dialogues.en: In truth, I woke up just past 9.
dialogues.text: In truth, I woke up just past 9.

dialogues.jp: 音夢は俺より早起きだった。
dialogues.en: Nemu apparently woke up earlier than me.
dialogues.text: Nemu apparently woke up earlier than me.

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、俺が起きる前に買い物に出かけたら
しい。
dialogues.en: It seems she went shopping before I woke up.
dialogues.text: It seems she went shopping before I woke up.

dialogues.jp:
テーブルに『美春と買い物に行ってきます』と
いう置手紙がある。
dialogues.en:
The note on the table that said "I went shopping with
Miharu" was a slight hint to that.
dialogues.text:
The note on the table that said "I went shopping with
Miharu" was a slight hint to that.

dialogues.jp: 女の子って本当に買い物好きだよな。
dialogues.en: Girls sure like to go shopping lots...
dialogues.text: Girls sure like to go shopping lots...

dialogues.jp:
俺や杉並は、商店街に行ったところで、買い物
をすることなんて滅多にない。
dialogues.en:
When Suginami and I go to the shopping district, actually
shopping is the last thing on our minds.
dialogues.text:
When Suginami and I go to the shopping district, actually
shopping is the last thing on our minds.

dialogues.jp:
ゲーセンに行って、格闘ものやＳＦ系のゲーム
で男の勝負をするぐらいだ。
dialogues.en:
It's usually challenging each other to fighting or SF games
in the arcades.
dialogues.text:
It's usually challenging each other to fighting or SF games
in the arcades.

dialogues.jp:
そうでなければ、このように昼まで寝てて、パ
ジャマのままで起きて、居間でダラダラと……。
dialogues.en:
Despite that though, the feeling of lazing around in the
living room, in pajamas, just before noon...
dialogues.text:
Despite that though, the feeling of lazing around in the
living room, in pajamas, just before noon...

dialogues.jp: こんな、自堕落な休日も悪くない……。
dialogues.en: This kind of brainless school holiday doesn't feel bad.
dialogues.text: This kind of brainless school holiday doesn't feel bad.

dialogues.jp:
と、いつもなら思うのだが、さっきから心の中
のモヤモヤが晴れない。
dialogues.en:
...Well, except for that nagging feeling clouding up my
heart.
dialogues.text:
...Well, except for that nagging feeling clouding up my
heart.

dialogues.jp:
気がつくと、何かしら環のことを考えているよ
うな気がする。
dialogues.en:
I eventually realized what it signified; I was thinking
about Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
I eventually realized what it signified; I was thinking
about Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
テレビでは、お笑い芸人に代わって、水着の女
の子が白菜と一緒に鍋の中に入った。
dialogues.en:
On the TV, in place of the comedians, girls in swimsuits
were jumping into the pot.
dialogues.text:
On the TV, in place of the comedians, girls in swimsuits
were jumping into the pot.

dialogues.jp:
別に、どうでもいい。水着の女の子を見ても、
特に感慨はなかった。
dialogues.en: But even those weren't enough to catch my attention.
dialogues.text: But even those weren't enough to catch my attention.

dialogues.jp:
不思議なことに、テレビの内容がちっとも頭に
入らない。
dialogues.en: The stuff being shown on TV simply wasn't entering my brain.
dialogues.text: The stuff being shown on TV simply wasn't entering my brain.

dialogues.jp: 頭に浮かぶのは、環のことばかりだ。
dialogues.en: My thoughts were filled only of Tamaki.
dialogues.text: My thoughts were filled only of Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 何でこんなに、気になるんだろう……。
dialogues.en: Why'm I thinking so much of her...
dialogues.text: Why'm I thinking so much of her...

dialogues.jp:
昨日、聞きたかったことが聞けなかったからだ
ろうか？
dialogues.en:
Because of the things yesterday that I wanted to tell her,
but couldn't?
dialogues.text:
Because of the things yesterday that I wanted to tell her,
but couldn't?

dialogues.jp: 小さい頃の、二人の記憶……。
dialogues.en: The memories of when we were kids...
dialogues.text: The memories of when we were kids...

dialogues.jp: やっと思い出した、｛まき／槙｝の木の上での出来事。
dialogues.en:
When I comforted her from the treetop... I finally
remembered it.
dialogues.text:
When I comforted her from the treetop... I finally
remembered it.

dialogues.jp: 気になる。
dialogues.en: I couldn't stop thinking about it.
dialogues.text: I couldn't stop thinking about it.

dialogues.jp:
っていうか、ここであれこれ考えてても、何も
始まらんだろ。
dialogues.en:
And until I resolve it, I won't be able to concentrate on
anything else.
dialogues.text:
And until I resolve it, I won't be able to concentrate on
anything else.

dialogues.jp: 「神社に行ってみるか……」
dialogues.en: "I'd go to the shrine..."
dialogues.text: "I'd go to the shrine..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は急いでテレビを消し、居間を出た。
dialogues.en:
I quickly switched off the TV, and headed out of the living
room.
dialogues.text:
I quickly switched off the TV, and headed out of the living
room.

dialogues.jp:
石段は、相変わらず多いが、今日は不思議と苦
にならなかった。
dialogues.en:
The ever-long flight of stone steps didn't seem nearly as
troublesome today.
dialogues.text:
The ever-long flight of stone steps didn't seem nearly as
troublesome today.

dialogues.jp:
少しずつ、慣れてきてしまったのもあるのだろ
うが、それより、環に会えるからかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Bit by bit, I'm getting used to the climb... and knowing I'd
see Tamaki after it helps, too.
dialogues.text:
Bit by bit, I'm getting used to the climb... and knowing I'd
see Tamaki after it helps, too.

dialogues.jp: あと少し、あと一段上れば、環に会えるだろう。
dialogues.en: Just a little bit more, and I can meet her.
dialogues.text: Just a little bit more, and I can meet her.

dialogues.jp:
と、思っていたら、今日は環ではない他の人が
境内を掃除していた。
dialogues.en:
...But just my luck, rather than Tamaki, it was someone else
sweeping the shrine grounds.
dialogues.text:
...But just my luck, rather than Tamaki, it was someone else
sweeping the shrine grounds.

dialogues.jp:
あれ？　どうも見覚えがある人だな。小さい頃
会ったことがあるような気がする。
dialogues.en:
Hm... I feel like I've seen him before, in my childhood
days.
dialogues.text:
Hm... I feel like I've seen him before, in my childhood
days.

dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Good afternoon."
dialogues.text: "Good afternoon."

dialogues.jp: 俺はその人に、礼儀正しく挨拶をする。
dialogues.en: I politely adressed the man.
dialogues.text: I politely adressed the man.

dialogues.jp:
神主は俺を見ると、ふと考え……たちまち何か
を思い出したように、優しく相好を崩した。
dialogues.en:
He turned to face me, and thought for a bit... then,
seemingly remembering something, smiled gently.
dialogues.text:
He turned to face me, and thought for a bit... then,
seemingly remembering something, smiled gently.

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「おやおや、久しぶりだね。朝倉くん……だっ
　たかな？　なんとなく面影が残っている」
dialogues.en:
"Hoho, it's been a long time. Asakura-kun, was it? Your
looks haven't changed since."
dialogues.text:
"Hoho, it's been a long time. Asakura-kun, was it? Your
looks haven't changed since."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp: 「え？　どうして、俺の名前を」
dialogues.en: "Eh? How do you know my name?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? How do you know my name?"

dialogues.jp: やはり、会ったことがあるのだろうか。
dialogues.en: We must've really have met before...
dialogues.text: We must've really have met before...

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、無理もない。私がここにいたのも、君
　や環が子どもの頃だからね」
dialogues.en:
"It isn't surprising that you don't remember. The last time
I was here, Tamaki and you were just wee kids."
dialogues.text:
"It isn't surprising that you don't remember. The last time
I was here, Tamaki and you were just wee kids."

dialogues.jp: 環が……って、じゃあ、この人は。
dialogues.en: Tamaki..., then, this man must be...
dialogues.text: Tamaki..., then, this man must be...

dialogues.jp:
「あの……、もしかして、環……胡ノ宮さんの
　お父さんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Um... would you be Tamaki... er, Konomiya's father?"
dialogues.text: "Um... would you be Tamaki... er, Konomiya's father?"

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「そう……、胡ノ宮環のお父さんです。娘から
　話は聞いているよ。いつもお世話になってお
　ります」
dialogues.en:
"Yes... I would be. I have heard from my daughter that you
have been very good to her."
dialogues.text:
"Yes... I would be. I have heard from my daughter that you
have been very good to her."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「いえいえ、こちらこそ、環さんにはお世話に
　なっております」
dialogues.en:
"No no, it's the same here, she's been a very good friend to
me too."
dialogues.text:
"No no, it's the same here, she's been a very good friend to
me too."

dialogues.jp:
ぺこりと挨拶をするお父さんに、思わず俺の方
も井戸端の奥様よろしくぺこりと挨拶を返して
しまう。
dialogues.en:
He bowed so politely to me, that I felt obliged to do the
same.
dialogues.text:
He bowed so politely to me, that I felt obliged to do the
same.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、大きくなったものだ。私が知っ
　ているのはまだこのくらいの頃だったからね」
dialogues.en: "You really have grown. The lad I knew was just this tall."
dialogues.text: "You really have grown. The lad I knew was just this tall."

dialogues.jp:
お父さんは、手の平を出して、俺の胸の下くら
いを指す。
dialogues.en: The father held out his hand, roughly at my chest level.
dialogues.text: The father held out his hand, roughly at my chest level.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「ただ、環とは仲良くなる前に私の都合で引っ
　越してしまったからね。といっても、当時も
　ここへ手伝いに来ていただけだが」
dialogues.en:
"It was a shame that we had to move just when you two became
close. We were only helping out here, after all."
dialogues.text:
"It was a shame that we had to move just when you two became
close. We were only helping out here, after all."

dialogues.jp:
お父さんが、はっはっはと笑う。どうやら、こ
こは、環の母方の家だったらしく、宮司の都合
により代理を務めたりすることがあるようだ。
dialogues.en:
Seems like her father really was just a substitute for the
main priest here...
dialogues.text:
Seems like her father really was just a substitute for the
main priest here...

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「ただ、不思議なことに、環はなぜか当時の初
　音島の記憶を失っていてね」
dialogues.en:
"It is strange, though... Tamaki does not retain any
memories of her time here."
dialogues.text:
"It is strange, though... Tamaki does not retain any
memories of her time here."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「確か、そんなことを言ってました。幼い頃の
　記憶がない、と」
dialogues.en:
"She has said before, that she has no recollection of her
childhood days."
dialogues.text:
"She has said before, that she has no recollection of her
childhood days."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「どういうわけか、医者に診せても原因はわか
　らずじまいだったよ。なぜか、妻はさほど心
　配そうではなかったけれど」
dialogues.en:
"An examination from a doctor was unfruitful as well. My
wife wasn't worried at all about it, though."
dialogues.text:
"An examination from a doctor was unfruitful as well. My
wife wasn't worried at all about it, though."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「あの……なんだか、とても聞きづらいんです
　が、一つ聞いていいですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Um... what I'm about to ask might be a bit weird, is that
okay?"
dialogues.text:
"Um... what I'm about to ask might be a bit weird, is that
okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、かまわないよ。答えられることなら、
　なんでも答えてあげよう」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, please do. I will answer to the best of my ability."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, please do. I will answer to the best of my ability."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「俺……環──環さんから、｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝なんて言われ
　てるんですが、何か知っていますか？」
dialogues.en:
"Do you know anything about why Tamaki...san, refers to me
as her fiance?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you know anything about why Tamaki...san, refers to me
as her fiance?"

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp: 「許嫁？　君と環がかい？」
dialogues.en: "Fiance? Tamaki thinks of you as that?"
dialogues.text: "Fiance? Tamaki thinks of you as that?"

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp: 「は、はい……。変な話でスミマセン」
dialogues.en:
"Y, yes... sorry for talking about something as weird as
this..."
dialogues.text:
"Y, yes... sorry for talking about something as weird as
this..."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「いや、いいんだよ。私もその話は聞いている
　からね」
dialogues.en: "It's alright. I have also heard a little about that."
dialogues.text: "It's alright. I have also heard a little about that."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「妻がね、よく言っていたよ。あなたには許嫁
　がいるのよって。あなたは朝倉くんと深い絆
　で結ばれているのって」
dialogues.en:
"My wife constantly told her, that she has a fiancee. That
Asakura-kun was bonded deeply to her."
dialogues.text:
"My wife constantly told her, that she has a fiancee. That
Asakura-kun was bonded deeply to her."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「そう、俺も、そういうことを言われたんです
　よ、環に」
dialogues.en: "Yes, Tamaki has told me about that part."
dialogues.text: "Yes, Tamaki has told me about that part."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ざっと昨日の夢のことを話してみた。た
だ、環が予知能力者であるというところは、と
りあえずぼかしておいて。
dialogues.en:
I vaguely remember that from yesterday's dream too, but the
whole clairvoyance part overshadowed it.
dialogues.text:
I vaguely remember that from yesterday's dream too, but the
whole clairvoyance part overshadowed it.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、そういうことだったのか。許嫁とは、
　君と環の子どもの時の約束、ということか」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, so you know that it was a promise made, when you and
Tamaki were kids."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, so you know that it was a promise made, when you and
Tamaki were kids."

dialogues.jp:
少しばかり悩むところがあったらしい。お父さ
んは少し大げさなくらいに、顔を覆って笑って
いた。
dialogues.en:
He seemed thoughtful for a while, but his face eventually
broke out into a wide smile.
dialogues.text:
He seemed thoughtful for a while, but his face eventually
broke out into a wide smile.

dialogues.jp:
そりゃあ、娘の許嫁の話を傍目に聞いていて、
いい気がする父親はいないだろう。
dialogues.en: He certainly doesn't seem a stranger to the situation...
dialogues.text: He certainly doesn't seem a stranger to the situation...

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、私はそれを横で聞いていながら、記憶
　喪失になった環を、励ましているのだろうと
　思っていたがね」
dialogues.en:
"Well, even if I didn't know that, I would still support my
amnesia-ridden daughter."
dialogues.text:
"Well, even if I didn't know that, I would still support my
amnesia-ridden daughter."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「環の話に寄れば、俺と環には『深い絆』があ
　るそうです。できれば、お母さんにも話が聞
　きたいんですが……」
dialogues.en:
"...Leaving that aside, there's the matter of that "deep
bond". I wanted to talk to Tamaki's mother about that..."
dialogues.text:
"...Leaving that aside, there's the matter of that "deep
bond". I wanted to talk to Tamaki's mother about that..."

dialogues.jp:
結局は、どうも母親の方に話を聞かないとわか
らない。
dialogues.en:
In the end, until I hear it from the woman herself, I doubt
I'd ever understand.
dialogues.text:
In the end, until I hear it from the woman herself, I doubt
I'd ever understand.

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp: 「うーん、残念だが、妻は他界していてね」
dialogues.en: "Mmm, unfortunately, she's at the other world now."
dialogues.text: "Mmm, unfortunately, she's at the other world now."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp: 「えっ」
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「いわゆる、男手一つでってやつだ。その割に
　は環はよく育ってくれたよ」
dialogues.en:
"And, despite how she brought Tamaki up, she was quite the
independent woman."
dialogues.text:
"And, despite how she brought Tamaki up, she was quite the
independent woman."

dialogues.jp:
お父さんは、眉間を指で押さえながらうんうん
と頷いている。過去を思い出して、悦に入って
いるように見える。
dialogues.en:
He tapped his forehead with his finger, seemingly recalling
sweet memories of days gone by.
dialogues.text:
He tapped his forehead with his finger, seemingly recalling
sweet memories of days gone by.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「それに、妻はなぜあんなことを言っていたの
　か、私にも理由を教えてくれなかったよ」
dialogues.en:
"Thus, she never explained to me the reason for why she said
what she did."
dialogues.text:
"Thus, she never explained to me the reason for why she said
what she did."

dialogues.jp:
君の言話を聞くまで、私は何も知らなかったよ
と、笑って言った。
dialogues.en:
I know what you want to hear, but I don't know anything...
was basically what he was saying.
dialogues.text:
I know what you want to hear, but I don't know anything...
was basically what he was saying.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「しかし、環は妻の言葉を｛かて／糧｝にしてきたみたい
　だね」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki seems to have taken what she said to heart."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki seems to have taken what she said to heart."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「環はね、前の学校じゃ、随分といじめられて
　いたみたいでね。それで、学校を変えること
　にしたんだが」
dialogues.en:
"Tamaki was constantly bullied in her previous school...
that's why we moved back here."
dialogues.text:
"Tamaki was constantly bullied in her previous school...
that's why we moved back here."

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「え？　ここの宮司さんが病気で引っ越してき
　たって聞いてますが……」
dialogues.en:
"Ehh? I thought it was because the priest here had fallen
ill..."
dialogues.text:
"Ehh? I thought it was because the priest here had fallen
ill..."

dialogues.jp: 確かに……あの夢の中で、環は……。
dialogues.en: Although... in that dream, Tamaki was definitely...
dialogues.text: Although... in that dream, Tamaki was definitely...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「表向きだよ。まさか、いじめから逃げるため
　なんて、環もいい気がしないだろうからね。
　あの子を救うための口実だよ」
dialogues.en:
"That was the excuse we used, yes. Even Tamaki herself
doesn't know the truth."
dialogues.text:
"That was the excuse we used, yes. Even Tamaki herself
doesn't know the truth."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「実は、何度か同じようなことを繰り返してい
　るんだ。毎回、口実を考えるのが大変だけれ
　どね」
dialogues.en:
"But it is a far-too-common occurence... every time, we'd
have to think of newer and less-believable excuses."
dialogues.text:
"But it is a far-too-common occurence... every time, we'd
have to think of newer and less-believable excuses."

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、代理というのも本当だが、とお父さ
んは笑って言った。ここの宮司は、病弱らしい。
dialogues.en:
Although the part of the priest being ill was true,
according to him. It just happened to be convenient.
dialogues.text:
Although the part of the priest being ill was true,
according to him. It just happened to be convenient.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「今回、もう一度初音島へ行くことになったっ
　て言ったら、あの子は随分喜んでいたよ。
　『朝倉様』に会えるってね」
dialogues.en:
"This time though, she was extremely excited about going to
Hatsu-nejima, and meeting "Asakura-sama"."
dialogues.text:
"This time though, she was extremely excited about going to
Hatsu-nejima, and meeting "Asakura-sama"."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「私がこっちに来てからは、ずっと君の話ばか
　りだったよ」
dialogues.en:
Nary a day goes by since we came here, without her talking
about you."
dialogues.text:
Nary a day goes by since we came here, without her talking
about you."

dialogues.jp: 環が、そんなに……俺のことを。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's been... that way, about me?
dialogues.text: Tamaki's been... that way, about me?

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「君は随分、環に慕われているようだね。これ
　は将来は本当に結婚かな？」
dialogues.en:
"Tamaki appears to treasure and love you very much. Shall
you really get married in the future?"
dialogues.text:
"Tamaki appears to treasure and love you very much. Shall
you really get married in the future?"

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp: 「や、俺は……その」
dialogues.en: "Ah, uh, that's..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, uh, that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「ははは、わかっているよ。子どもの頃の約束
　を押しつけたりはしないさ」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha, I was just kidding. I won't force a child's promise
onto you."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha, I was just kidding. I won't force a child's promise
onto you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp: 「──もちろん、君が本気なら、話は別だが」
dialogues.en:
"---Of course, if you were serious, that would be another
matter entirely."
dialogues.text:
"---Of course, if you were serious, that would be another
matter entirely."

dialogues.jp: お父さんの目が、キランと光った。
dialogues.en: A light flashed in his eyes.
dialogues.text: A light flashed in his eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君。環は、槙の木の下で掃除をしている
　から、顔を見せてやってくれないかな。環に
　会いに来たんだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-kun. Tamaki is currently sweeping underneath the
evergreen tree. Why don't you go see her?"
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-kun. Tamaki is currently sweeping underneath the
evergreen tree. Why don't you go see her?"

dialogues.speaker: Priest
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい。ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes, I will. Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes, I will. Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、お父さんに頭を下げると、槙の木の下に
向かった。
dialogues.en:
I bowed respectfully to the man, and headed for the
evergreen tree.
dialogues.text:
I bowed respectfully to the man, and headed for the
evergreen tree.

dialogues.jp: 同じ敷地内なのに、
dialogues.en: It was at the same place it always was,
dialogues.text: It was at the same place it always was,

dialogues.jp: 槙の木まで遠く感じる。
dialogues.en: Yet today, it seemed further than usual.
dialogues.text: Yet today, it seemed further than usual.

dialogues.jp: 俺の脚に鉛がついたみたいに。
dialogues.en: My feet felt like they were made of lead.
dialogues.text: My feet felt like they were made of lead.

dialogues.jp:
俺の体が、スローモーションにでもなったみた
いに。
dialogues.en: As if my whole body was moving in slow motion.
dialogues.text: As if my whole body was moving in slow motion.

dialogues.jp: はやる気持ちが、動作を鈍く感じさせる。
dialogues.en:
The thoughts swirling around my head were dulling my
movements.
dialogues.text:
The thoughts swirling around my head were dulling my
movements.

dialogues.jp: やっと槙の木が見えて来る。
dialogues.en: But eventually, the evergreen tree came into sight.
dialogues.text: But eventually, the evergreen tree came into sight.

dialogues.jp: 御神木の柵の中に……。
dialogues.en: Inside the fenced-off area covering the tree...
dialogues.text: Inside the fenced-off area covering the tree...

dialogues.jp:
白い白衣に、燃えるような緋色の袴を履いた環
がそこに静かに｛たたず／佇｝んでいた。
dialogues.en:
Was Tamaki, staring at the tree, In the brilliant red and
white of her Miko dress.
dialogues.text:
Was Tamaki, staring at the tree, In the brilliant red and
white of her Miko dress.

dialogues.jp: ｛たけぼうき／竹箒｝を持った手は動いてはいない。
dialogues.en:
She was holding a bamboo broom, but her hands didn't move
one bit.
dialogues.text:
She was holding a bamboo broom, but her hands didn't move
one bit.

dialogues.jp:
まるで会話をしているように槙の木を見上げて
いる。
dialogues.en:
She was looking up at the tree... as if she was
communicating with it.
dialogues.text:
She was looking up at the tree... as if she was
communicating with it.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、呼吸を整える。
dialogues.en: I calmed my breathing back down to a normal pace.
dialogues.text: I calmed my breathing back down to a normal pace.

dialogues.jp: 心臓が早鐘のように鳴り響き、耳が痛む。
dialogues.en: My heart was beating so fast, that the noise pained my ears.
dialogues.text: My heart was beating so fast, that the noise pained my ears.

dialogues.jp: そして、息を大きく吸う。
dialogues.en: And with a deep breath,
dialogues.text: And with a deep breath,

dialogues.en: "Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺の声に反応し、こちらに顔を向ける。
dialogues.en: Tamaki turned towards me, upon hearing my voice.
dialogues.text: Tamaki turned towards me, upon hearing my voice.

dialogues.jp:
彼女は、口を開くことなく、黒い瞳で俺をじっ
と見つめる。
dialogues.en: Her black eyes stared at me, her mouth never opening.
dialogues.text: Her black eyes stared at me, her mouth never opening.

dialogues.jp: 「懐かしいよな」
dialogues.en: "This brings back memories."
dialogues.text: "This brings back memories."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「最初に会ったのは、その木の上だった」
dialogues.en: "This was the site of the first time we met, after all."
dialogues.text: "This was the site of the first time we met, after all."

dialogues.jp:
そう言った途端、環の目が大きく見開く。息を
呑むのが、すぐにわかった。
dialogues.en:
THer eyes grew big once I finished my sentence. I could hear
her taking a big swallow.
dialogues.text:
THer eyes grew big once I finished my sentence. I could hear
her taking a big swallow.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……もしかして？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama... do you...?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama... do you...?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「思い出したよ」
dialogues.en: "I remember."
dialogues.text: "I remember."

dialogues.jp: 小さな小さな、二人の記憶を……。
dialogues.en: When we were so little, our memories...
dialogues.text: When we were so little, our memories...

dialogues.jp: 俺はゆっくりと、槙の木へ歩み寄る。
dialogues.en: I paced my way towards the tree.
dialogues.text: I paced my way towards the tree.

dialogues.jp: 柵を乗り越え、環の前へと立つ。
dialogues.en: I stepped over the fence, and stood in front of Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I stepped over the fence, and stood in front of Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 「この槙の木……」
dialogues.en: "This tree..."
dialogues.text: "This tree..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、槙の木の幹に触れる。
dialogues.en:
My hand reached out, touching the trunk of the enormous
tree.
dialogues.text:
My hand reached out, touching the trunk of the enormous
tree.

dialogues.jp: 「俺達、ずっと前に会ってたんだな」
dialogues.en: "This was where we met, a long time ago."
dialogues.text: "This was where we met, a long time ago."

dialogues.jp: 幼い頃、槙の木で話をした、あの日。
dialogues.en:
That day in our childhood, when we talked on top of the
tree.
dialogues.text:
That day in our childhood, when we talked on top of the
tree.

dialogues.jp: 俺が、環のために出してやった栗饅頭……。
dialogues.en: I had made a chestnut manjuu for her...
dialogues.text: I had made a chestnut manjuu for her...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の顔を見据える。
dialogues.en: I gazed at her face.
dialogues.text: I gazed at her face.

dialogues.jp: 環の瞳の中に、俺の顔が映っている。
dialogues.en: I saw my reflection in her eyes.
dialogues.text: I saw my reflection in her eyes.

dialogues.jp:
環は、びっくりしたような顔をしていたが、目
に涙が浮かんできている。
dialogues.en:
Her face eventually changed from one of astonishment, to one
with tears dropping from her eyes.
dialogues.text:
Her face eventually changed from one of astonishment, to one
with tears dropping from her eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「やっと……」
dialogues.en: "Finally..."
dialogues.text: "Finally..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、白衣の袖で、涙を拭う。
dialogues.en: She wiped her tears away with her sleeve.
dialogues.text: She wiped her tears away with her sleeve.

dialogues.jp: そして、笑顔で言った。
dialogues.en: And then, a smile.
dialogues.text: And then, a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「思い出してくれたんですね」
dialogues.en: "You do remember."
dialogues.text: "You do remember."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「遅くなってすまない」
dialogues.en: "Sorry for taking so long."
dialogues.text: "Sorry for taking so long."

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉に、環は首を横に振る。
dialogues.en: She shook her head furiously at my apology.
dialogues.text: She shook her head furiously at my apology.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいんです、もう……」
dialogues.en: "No, it's fine..."
dialogues.text: "No, it's fine..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「思い出してくれれば、それだけで……」
dialogues.en: "As long as you remember, that's..."
dialogues.text: "As long as you remember, that's..."

dialogues.jp: 環は笑顔で俺に言う。
dialogues.en: Her smile to me never wavered.
dialogues.text: Her smile to me never wavered.

dialogues.jp: しかし、目からは涙が溢れ出している。
dialogues.en: Yet, the tears continued to flow from her eyes.
dialogues.text: Yet, the tears continued to flow from her eyes.

dialogues.jp: そんな環を俺はただ、見守ることしかできない。
dialogues.en: I couldn't do anything, but watch over her.
dialogues.text: I couldn't do anything, but watch over her.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当に、よかった……」
dialogues.en: "I'm really glad..."
dialogues.text: "I'm really glad..."

dialogues.jp:
環の涙は、次から次へと溢れ、白衣に染みを作っ
ていく。
dialogues.en: Her numerous tears began to stain her sleeve.
dialogues.text: Her numerous tears began to stain her sleeve.

dialogues.jp:
覚えていないはずの環は、はらはらと涙をこぼ
した。
dialogues.en:
Even though she should have no recollection of it herself,
her tears still continued.
dialogues.text:
Even though she should have no recollection of it herself,
her tears still continued.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、俺の方だけでも、ふたりを結ぶ記憶を思
い出しただけで彼女にしてみれば、充分だった
のだろうか。
dialogues.en:
Perhaps, it's enough that just one of us remembered the bond
we had.
dialogues.text:
Perhaps, it's enough that just one of us remembered the bond
we had.

dialogues.jp: ふたりが、した結婚の約束……。
dialogues.en: The promise that we made, to marry...
dialogues.text: The promise that we made, to marry...

dialogues.jp: 「泣くなよ……」
dialogues.en: "Don't cry..."
dialogues.text: "Don't cry..."

dialogues.jp: 子供だましだとは思うが。
dialogues.en: The situation reminded me of our childhood days.
dialogues.text: The situation reminded me of our childhood days.

dialogues.jp: 俺は栗饅頭をイメージする。
dialogues.en: An image of a chestnut manjuu formed in my head.
dialogues.text: An image of a chestnut manjuu formed in my head.

dialogues.jp: 体のカロリーが減っていくのを感じながら。
dialogues.en: I could feel the calories seeping out of my body.
dialogues.text: I could feel the calories seeping out of my body.

dialogues.jp: でも、心の中は温かい気持ちでいっぱいになる。
dialogues.en: But the gentle, warm feeling in my heart made up for it.
dialogues.text: But the gentle, warm feeling in my heart made up for it.

dialogues.en: "Take this..."
dialogues.text: "Take this..."

dialogues.jp: 環の手を取り、栗饅頭を乗せる。
dialogues.en: I placed the chestnut manjuu in her hand.
dialogues.text: I placed the chestnut manjuu in her hand.

dialogues.jp: 環は急いで涙を拭き、笑顔になる。
dialogues.en: She quickly wiped her tears away, smiling happily.
dialogues.text: She quickly wiped her tears away, smiling happily.

dialogues.jp: 一口、口に含む。
dialogues.en: She took the whole thing in her mouth.
dialogues.text: She took the whole thing in her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おいしい……」
dialogues.en: "Delicious..."
dialogues.text: "Delicious..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おいしい……です」
dialogues.en: "It's... delicious..."
dialogues.text: "It's... delicious..."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、また環の瞳から涙が零れる。
dialogues.en: And once again, the rain of tears began to fall.
dialogues.text: And once again, the rain of tears began to fall.

dialogues.jp:
もし、彼女の中に記憶があるのなら、きっと口
の中はあの日と同じ味でいっぱいになっている
んだろう。
dialogues.en:
If she does hold memories of that day, surely that taste
will remind her of it...
dialogues.text:
If she does hold memories of that day, surely that taste
will remind her of it...

dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp: 少しでも、環の役に立てるのなら、よかった。
dialogues.en: I was glad that I could be helpful to Tamaki in some way.
dialogues.text: I was glad that I could be helpful to Tamaki in some way.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、こんなことでぐらいしか、環を慰められ
ないから……。
dialogues.en: I couldn't comfort her, or fix anything for her otherwise...
dialogues.text: I couldn't comfort her, or fix anything for her otherwise...

dialogues.jp:
環が笑顔になるのなら、こんなに嬉しいことは
ない。
dialogues.en: She was smiling, but I wasn't happy about it.
dialogues.text: She was smiling, but I wasn't happy about it.

dialogues.jp: 環には、いつも笑っていて欲しいから……。
dialogues.en: I want to see her smiling, always...
dialogues.text: I want to see her smiling, always...

dialogues.jp: そのためなら、俺はどんなことでもしよう。
dialogues.en: What can I do, I wonder.
dialogues.text: What can I do, I wonder.

dialogues.jp: 環が笑ってくれるのなら……。
dialogues.en: To make sure she never stops smiling...
dialogues.text: To make sure she never stops smiling...

dialogues.jp:
あの日、子どもの約束だとしても、ふたりの未
来を約束したのだから……。
dialogues.en:
That day, and the promise that we made as kids, the promise
for our future...
dialogues.text:
That day, and the promise that we made as kids, the promise
for our future...

dialogues.jp:
そして、それを思い出した俺は、少し胸がいっ
ぱいになっていた。
dialogues.en: Those feelings and memories filled up my chest.
dialogues.text: Those feelings and memories filled up my chest.

dialogues.jp: ◆小さな頃の……◆
dialogues.en: ?◆When We Were Small...?◆
dialogues.text: ?◆When We Were Small...?◆

dialogues.jp:
環のことが気になり神社に訪れると、神主であ
る環のお父さんに出会う。
dialogues.en:
Thinking about Tamaki, I went to the shrine, where I met her
father.
dialogues.text:
Thinking about Tamaki, I went to the shrine, where I met her
father.

dialogues.jp:
環の昔の話を聞き、なんとなくあの夢が真実で
あったことに気づく。
dialogues.en:
I talked with him about Tamaki's youth, and realized my
dream was the truth.
dialogues.text:
I talked with him about Tamaki's youth, and realized my
dream was the truth.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環に会い、昔のことを思い出したと伝え
る。すると環は泣いて喜ぶのだった。
dialogues.en:
I then met Tamaki, and let her know that I remembered about
our past. It caused her to weep with joy.
dialogues.text:
I then met Tamaki, and let her know that I remembered about
our past. It caused her to weep with joy.

dialogues.jp:
そして、昔のように和菓子を出すと環は泣きや
み、笑顔を浮かべるのだった。
dialogues.en:
I produced another wagashi to stop her tears, and she
replied with a smile.
dialogues.text:
I produced another wagashi to stop her tears, and she
replied with a smile.

dialogues.jp: まるで、あの時と同じように……。
dialogues.en: It was just like that time...
dialogues.text: It was just like that time...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、守らなければならない。
dialogues.en: In the end, I couldn't protect her.
dialogues.text: In the end, I couldn't protect her.
